proposed_comments.title: Restore realized items through the active view
Wire grid container realization tracking
proposed_comments.body:
### Wire grid container realization tracking

**Severity:** `high`

`ItemsGrid` uses the same item source as the list but does not subscribe to `ContainerContentChanging`, so visible grid rows never create realization demand. Please add `ContainerContentChanging="Items_ContainerContentChanging"` to the `ItemsGrid` declaration as well. This is a general note because that declaration is outside the current diff range.

proposed_comments.title: Clean up list view models when clearing navigation history
proposed_comments.body:
### Clean up list view models when clearing navigation history

**Severity:** `high`

Suspending every departing list correctly preserves pages that remain reachable through Back, but a non-nested navigation immediately clears the back stack. Those discarded list view models keep their model subscriptions and item graph unless they are cleaned up before the entries are removed. Before `RootFrame.BackStack.Clear()`, clean up list view models retained in its navigation parameters. This is a general note because the navigation host is outside the current diff range.

review.body: The visible-item prioritization needs to cover grid realization and navigation-history cleanup before this is ready.

judgment.rationale: The current implementation hard-codes list realization in one recovery path, omits the grid realization event hook, and suspends list view models that can then be discarded from navigation history without cleanup.
evidence: The control selects list or grid through ItemView, but RegisterExistingRealizedItems directly searches ItemsList.
ItemsGrid lacks the ContainerContentChanging hook used to create visible-row demand.
Non-nested navigation clears BackStack entries after list view models are suspended, without invoking cleanup.
